statements: The Vigilance & Enforcement wing issued a report on suspected cartelisation in drain works contracts in three Urban Local Bodies, 2023–25.
The Vigilance & Enforcement wing conducted a confidential analysis of 46 drain works contracts awarded during 2023–25 in three Urban Local Bodies.
The wing reported that in 31 of the 46 contracts, the same four bidders participated, and the lowest bid was within 0.5% of the estimate in 27 cases, indicating possible bid rotation.
The wing recommended mandatory e-procurement analytics for works above Rs.25 lakhs and rotation of officers handling tender evaluation.

statements: For the 2025 general transfers, employees who have completed five (5) years of service at a station as on 30-04-2025 shall be transferred compulsorily.
The station period for the 2025 transfers is computed with reference to the total continuous service.
Periods of leave not exceeding six months shall be counted towards the station period, while periods of deputation outside the Department shall not be counted.
Where an employee has been transferred within the same headquarters town, the service at both offices shall be treated as service at one station.
